homepage.heroDescription: Un sistema integral de gestión clínica compatible con HIPAA/GDPR diseñado para prácticas de atención médica modernas. Administra pacientes, citas, recetas, facturación y más en una sola plataforma.
homepage.featuresTitle: Todo Lo Que Necesitas Para Gestionar Tu Clínica
homepage.featuresDescription: Funciones potentes diseñadas para ayudar a los profesionales de la salud a brindar una mejor atención al paciente mientras gestionan su práctica de manera eficiente.
homepage.patientManagementDesc: Registros completos de pacientes con PHI cifrado, historial médico, alergias y medicamentos. IDs de pacientes generados automáticamente y capacidades de búsqueda completas.
homepage.appointmentSchedulingDesc: Programación inteligente con detección de conflictos, seguimiento de estado y recordatorios automatizados. Soporte para múltiples tipos de citas y gestión de cola en tiempo real.
homepage.clinicalNotesDesc: Notas SOAP con control de versiones, plantillas y almacenamiento cifrado. Rastrea signos vitales, diagnósticos con códigos ICD-10/SNOMED CT y mantén pistas de auditoría completas.
homepage.prescriptionsDesc: Gestión de recetas específica de la región con base de datos de medicamentos, seguimiento de renovaciones y flujo de trabajo de dispensación. Soporte para firmas electrónicas y cumplimiento regional.
homepage.billingInvoicingDesc: Facturación integral con cálculos de impuestos específicos de la región, soporte multi-moneda, seguimiento de pagos y gestión de cobertura de seguros.
homepage.inventoryManagementDesc: Rastrea medicamentos y suministros con gestión de lotes/vencimiento, alertas de stock bajo, gestión de proveedores y seguimiento automatizado de transacciones.
homepage.queueManagementDesc: Seguimiento de cola en tiempo real con soporte para pacientes sin cita, gestión de prioridades, estimación de tiempo de espera y flujos de trabajo de registro/salida sin problemas para un flujo eficiente de pacientes.
homepage.reportsAnalyticsDesc: Informes integrales con resúmenes financieros, estadísticas de pacientes, análisis de citas, informes de inventario y exportaciones personalizables para la toma de decisiones basada en datos.
homepage.automatedRemindersDesc: Recordatorios de citas multicanal vía SMS, correo electrónico y WhatsApp. Plantillas personalizables, flexibilidad de programación y seguimiento de entrega para reducir las ausencias y mejorar el compromiso del paciente.
homepage.multiLanguageSupportDesc: Plataforma lista para el mundo con soporte i18n para múltiples idiomas, plantillas específicas de la región para recetas y facturas, y formatos de fecha/hora y moneda localizados.
homepage.mobileReadyPlatformDesc: Diseño completamente responsivo optimizado para tabletas y smartphones. Arquitectura API-first lista para aplicaciones móviles nativas, permitiendo a los profesionales de la salud gestionar su clínica sobre la marcha.
homepage.multiLocationSupportDesc: Gestiona múltiples ubicaciones de clínica desde un solo panel con registros de pacientes centralizados, informes unificados y configuraciones específicas de ubicación para operaciones multi-sitio sin problemas.
homepage.securityDescription: Funciones de seguridad y cumplimiento de nivel empresarial para proteger los datos de los pacientes y cumplir con los requisitos regulatorios.
homepage.hipaaCompliantDesc: Cumplimiento completo con las regulaciones HIPAA
homepage.gdprReadyDesc: Cumple con los requisitos GDPR para la protección de datos
homepage.auditLogsDesc: Pista de auditoría completa para todas las operaciones
homepage.testimonialsDescription: Confiable por profesionales de la salud en todo el mundo para optimizar las operaciones de su clínica y brindar una atención al paciente excepcional.
homepage.testimonial1: Doctor's Clinic has transformed how we manage our practice. The patient management system is intuitive, and the automated reminders have reduced our no-show rate by 40%. Highly recommend!
homepage.testimonial2: The billing and invoicing features are fantastic. Region-specific tax calculations and multi-currency support make it perfect for our international clinic. Compliance features give us peace of mind.
homepage.testimonial3: Queue management has been a game-changer for our busy clinic. The real-time tracking and wait time estimates help us provide better patient experiences. Setup was quick and the support team is excellent.
homepage.testimonial4: As someone managing multiple clinic locations, the multi-location support is exactly what we needed. Centralized patient records and unified reporting save us hours every week. Worth every penny!
homepage.testimonial5: The clinical notes feature with SOAP templates has streamlined our documentation process significantly. The encryption and audit logs ensure we meet all compliance requirements. Highly secure and efficient!
homepage.testimonial6: Inventory management has revolutionized how we track medicines and supplies. Low-stock alerts prevent shortages, and batch tracking ensures we maintain quality standards. The mobile-friendly interface is a huge plus!

homepage.ctaDescription: Únete a los profesionales de la salud que confían en Doctor's Clinic para gestionar su práctica de manera eficiente y segura.

subscriptionSpec.extraDoctorDesc: Add an additional doctor account to your plan. Each extra doctor gets full access to patient records, appointments, prescriptions, and clinical notes. Perfect for growing clinics that need more medical professionals.
subscriptionSpec.extraStaffDesc: Add additional staff accounts for receptionists, nurses, or assistants. Each staff member gets role-based access to manage appointments, patient records, and clinic operations based on their permissions.
subscriptionSpec.extraSmsDesc: Purchase additional SMS credits for appointment reminders and patient notifications. Choose from flexible packages: 100 SMS for small practices, 500 SMS for medium clinics, or 1000 SMS for high-volume operations.
subscriptionSpec.additionalStorageDesc: Expand your document storage capacity for patient files, lab reports, X-rays, and medical documents. Choose 25GB for moderate needs or 100GB for clinics with extensive documentation requirements.
subscriptionSpec.whatsAppDesc: Enable WhatsApp Business API integration to send appointment reminders, follow-ups, and patient communications directly through WhatsApp. Includes 500 messages per month with professional messaging templates.
subscriptionSpec.advancedReportsDesc: Unlock custom dashboards, advanced analytics, and detailed reporting tools. Create personalized reports for revenue, patient visits, doctor performance, and clinic metrics with real-time data visualization.

supportCenter.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Doctor's Clinic
supportCenter.stillNeedHelpDesc: Our support team is here to help you get the most out of Doctor's Clinic
supportCenter.faqQ1: How do I create an account?
supportCenter.faqA1: Click the "Get Started" button on our homepage or visit the registration page. You'll need to provide your clinic information and create an admin account. A 14-day free trial is available to get you started.
supportCenter.faqQ2: What information do I need to set up my clinic?
supportCenter.faqA2: You'll need basic clinic information including name, address, contact details, timezone, currency, and tax settings. You can also configure appointment types, consultation durations, and other clinic-specific settings.
supportCenter.faqA3: Currently, Doctor's Clinic is accessible through web browsers on desktop and mobile devices. We are working on native mobile apps for iOS and Android, which will be available in the future.
supportCenter.faqA4: Navigate to the Appointments section, click "New Appointment", and fill in the patient, doctor, date, time, and appointment type. The system will automatically check for conflicts and send reminders.
supportCenter.faqQ5: Can I customize clinical note templates?
supportCenter.faqA5: Yes! You can create custom note templates for different specialties, appointment types, or individual doctors. Templates support SOAP format and can include pre-filled sections.
supportCenter.faqA6: Prescriptions can be created during appointments, include region-specific drug information, and support refills. The system tracks prescription status (draft, active, dispensed) and maintains a complete audit trail.
supportCenter.faqA7: The billing system supports multiple payment methods including cash, card, UPI, bank transfer, cheque, and insurance. You can track partial payments and payment reconciliation.
supportCenter.faqA8: The system automatically monitors stock levels and sends alerts when items fall below the reorder point. You can also view expired items and low stock reports.
supportCenter.faqA9: Yes, Doctor's Clinic is designed to be HIPAA compliant. We implement encryption for PHI, maintain audit logs, use role-based access control, and execute Business Associate Agreements with healthcare providers.
supportCenter.faqA10: Protected Health Information (PHI) is encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. All data transmission uses TLS/SSL encryption. We never store PHI in logs or include it in notifications.
supportCenter.faqA11: Yes, you can export your data at any time. Contact support to request a data export, and we'll provide your data in a structured format. This is also available for GDPR compliance.
supportCenter.faqQ12: What happens to my data if I cancel?
supportCenter.faqA12: We retain your data for a period as required by law and healthcare regulations. You can request data export before cancellation. After the retention period, data is securely deleted or anonymized.
supportCenter.faqA13: We offer flexible pricing based on the number of users and features. Contact our sales team for detailed pricing information and to discuss which plan best fits your clinic's needs.
supportCenter.faqA14: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card is required to start your trial.
supportCenter.faqQ15: Can I change my plan later?
supportCenter.faqA15: Absolutely! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will be reflected in your next billing cycle.
supportCenter.faqQ16: What payment methods do you accept?
supportCenter.faqA16: We accept major credit cards, debit cards, and bank transfers. Annual plans may be eligible for discounts.
supportCenter.faqA17: Doctor's Clinic works best on modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend using the latest version of your preferred browser for optimal performance.
supportCenter.faqQ18: Do I need to install any software?
supportCenter.faqA18: No installation is required! Doctor's Clinic is a cloud-based platform accessible through your web browser. Just sign up and start using it immediately.
supportCenter.faqQ19: How do I report a bug or issue?
supportCenter.faqA19: You can report issues through the support contact form, email us at support@clinichub.com, or use the in-app feedback feature. We prioritize security and critical issues.
supportCenter.faqA20: Yes, Doctor's Clinic is built API-first to support future integrations and mobile apps. API documentation is available for enterprise customers. Contact us for API access.
